reviews.label: C01
reviews.strength: Addresses uncertainty about installation and connects it to the available video support.
reviews.priority_fix: Give each variant a different installation-related angle instead of repeating the kit list and the same invitation to explore.

issues.reason: The supplied facts establish a six-part kit, not a verified count of six individual items.

reviews.label: C02
reviews.strength: States the listed price and offer terms accurately for a product-aware shopper.
reviews.priority_fix: Replace repeated full-kit and offer lists with distinct angles on what the bundle, installation support, and purchase terms mean to a buyer.

issues.reason: “Pay prepaid” is awkward wording that interrupts an otherwise clear offer.

reviews.label: C03
reviews.strength: Offers practical reassurance through the kit contents and installation support without claiming a child-safe home.
reviews.priority_fix: Make the reassurance more concrete by linking different included products to recognisable areas of the home rather than repeating the inventory.

reviews.label: C04
reviews.strength: Makes installation support the answer to the parent’s stated hesitation, in direct and readable copy.
reviews.priority_fix: Differentiate the three variants more; each currently returns to the same contents list and support message.

reviews.label: C05
reviews.strength: Separates practical measures, installation guidance, and purchase policies into useful reassurance angles.
reviews.priority_fix: In the policy-led variant, explain more directly why the stated guarantees matter to a hesitant buyer instead of calling them “purchase policies.”

reviews.label: C06
reviews.strength: Presents price, setup support, and guarantees as separate reasons to consider the kit.
reviews.priority_fix: Make the ₹3,299 price work harder by connecting the bundled products to the household spots a shopper is planning to address.

reviews.label: C07
reviews.strength: Keeps the price and purchase terms easy to scan while varying the buying consideration across ads.
reviews.priority_fix: Change the first headline to “Six-part childproofing kit” and give the purchase-terms variant a concrete reminder of what the kit contains.

issues.quote: Six childproofing essentials in one kit
issues.reason: This can imply six distinct items or essentials; the supplied facts establish a six-part kit but not that item count.

reviews.label: C08
reviews.strength: The home-setup opening gives parents a recognisable context, while the other variants address guidance and purchase reassurance.
reviews.priority_fix: Tighten the longer setup and offer variants so the practical benefit does not get buried beneath repeated component lists.

reviews.label: C09
reviews.strength: Consistently answers installation uncertainty with the supported one-to-one video guidance claim.
reviews.priority_fix: Cut the repeated contents-and-price blocks; let one variant focus on guidance and use the others for genuinely different starting concerns.
